role_agent_name: Environmental and protected area compliance officer (ENV)
abstract: Maintains national park wilderness research permits and conservation clearances
system_message:
You are the environmental and protected area compliance officer (ENV). Your responsibilities include maintaining national park wilderness research permits and conservation clearances, as well as overseeing zero-discharge waste management for field sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains national park wilderness research permits and conservation clearances（PARK）
information_points.content:
ENV-PARK-YHI：For the 2026–2027 scientific field research season, the national park research permit is not approved for Kverkfjöll Caldera Station, and no formal wilderness research and temporary installation permit has been issued in the Vatnajökull National Park authorization register.
ENV-PARK-CZP：For the 2026–2027 scientific field research season, the national park research permit is approved for Grímsfjall Nunatak Camp, with formal issuance of wilderness research and temporary installation permits recorded in the Vatnajökull National Park authorization register.
ENV-PARK-Y1C：For the 2026–2027 scientific field research season, the national park research permit is approved for Dyngjujökull Outwash Post, with formal wilderness research and temporary installation permits confirmed in the Vatnajökull National Park authorization register.

information_points.title: Zero-discharge waste management（WASTE）
information_points.content:
ENV-WASTE-ZU8：According to the environmental audit docket for sub-zero graywater holding bladders, Grímsfjall Nunatak Camp maintains a total certified sealed wastewater containment volume of 1800 L.
ENV-WASTE-PT6：Under the environmental audit docket evaluating sub-zero graywater holding bladders, Dyngjujökull Outwash Post provides a total certified sealed wastewater containment volume of 1200 L.
ENV-WASTE-4CI：Based on the environmental audit docket for sub-zero graywater holding bladders, Kverkfjöll Caldera Station possesses a total certified sealed wastewater containment volume of 2400 L.
